candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POST /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500 Internal Server Error; traces and logs show the order 500 preceding each gateway 502 within the same correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service is not established; only the gateway-to-order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are consistently paired with downstream order 500s on /v1/orders in traces and logs, with short durations ruling out timeout-style latency. The proximate failing hop is order; its internal cause is not yet evidenced, so the bounded candidate is the http-500 propagation from order.
